rule: Secondary tone only for distinct surfaces or depth; continuous marks use one opaque tint.
reviewers: Three GPT-6.1 Sol agents at medium reasoning, with coordinator review of before/after examples and chart clearance.

geometryChanges.chart-donut: Opaque sectors use radial negative-space dividers to retain chart structure.
geometryChanges.trending-down: Raised arrowhead clear of chart baseline in all three styles, preventing the opacity change from exposing the existing collision.

knownDesignFindings: Earlier strict audit remains a historical baseline. Trending-down baseline collision is corrected; its other unresolved geometry/semantics findings remain open. This review approves the tone change and necessary clearance corrections, not the whole design system.
